Name: (CP) Grandpa's Farm Minecarts
Author: BrianOvaltine
Description:
This adds a minecart outside of Grandpa's Shed and the Greenhouse in Grandpa's Farm if you don't feel like walking all the way there every time. Compatible with Integrated Minecarts

Translations are welcome!
